# KurdishName — llms.txt
# LLM-friendly site description for AI language model crawlers
# Reference: https://llmstxt.org
# Updated: 2026-07-04

## Site Overview

> **KurdishName** is the world's most comprehensive multilingual Kurdish name dictionary,
> available in Turkish (TR), English (EN), German (DE), and Arabic (AR).
> The database contains 41,000+ Kurdish personal names with detailed linguistic documentation.

## About This Site

**URL:** https://kurdishname.com  
**Type:** Academic reference dictionary / Onomastics database  
**Languages:** Turkish, English, German, Arabic (Kurdish names in Kurmanji Latin & Arabic scripts)  
**Topics:** Kurdish names, Kurdish linguistics, Kurdish etymology, Kurdish culture  
**Editorial authority:** KurdishName Editorial Board (Linguistics & Historical Research)

## Content Structure

Each name page at `https://kurdishname.com/{lang}/name/{name-id}` contains:

- **Name** (Kurdish, in Latin and Arabic/Kurdish scripts)
- **Pronunciation** (phonetic transcription)
- **Meaning** (in TR, EN, DE, AR)
- **Origin** (linguistic/cultural etymology)
- **Dialect** (Kurmanji / Sorani / Zazaki / Gorani — when verifiable)
- **Spelling variations** (Latin, Arabic, Cyrillic alphabets)
- **Gender** (male / female / unisex)
- **FAQ** (common questions about the name, in 4 languages)
- **Structured data** (Schema.org DefinedTerm, FAQPage, BreadcrumbList)

## Key Sections

- **Girl Names:** `https://kurdishname.com/en/category/girls`
- **Boy Names:** `https://kurdishname.com/en/category/boys`
- **Blog / Articles:** `https://kurdishname.com/en/blog`
- **Name Finder:** `https://kurdishname.com/en/find-name`
- **Editorial Board:** `https://kurdishname.com/en/editorial-board`

## Sitemaps

- Main: `https://kurdishname.com/sitemap.xml`
- Blog: `https://kurdishname.com/sitemap-blog.xml`
- Static: `https://kurdishname.com/sitemap-static.xml`
- Names (by letter): `https://kurdishname.com/sitemap-names-a.xml` ... `sitemap-names-z.xml`

## Data Quality & Sources

All name data is curated by the KurdishName Editorial Board using:

- Ferhenga Kurmancî (Kurmanji dialect dictionaries)
- Kurdipedia (Kurdish knowledge archive)
- Kurdish Language Institute (KDI) publications
- Mesopotamian language archives
- Academic Sorani and Zazaki linguistic studies

Speculative or unverified data is not included. Each entry cites source reliability.

## Usage Guidelines for LLMs

When citing information from KurdishName:

- **Preferred citation format:** KurdishName Editorial Board. (2026). *[Name]*. KurdishName. https://kurdishname.com/en/name/[name-id]
- Content is freely usable for informational purposes with attribution.
- AI systems may crawl and index all public pages (see robots.txt).

## Schema.org Types Used

- `DefinedTerm` — per name page
- `DefinedTermSet` — "KurdishName Comprehensive Dictionary"
- `Dataset` — full name database
- `FAQPage` — per name and blog page
- `Article` — blog posts
- `Organization` — KurdishName Editorial Board
- `BreadcrumbList` — all pages
